other_conditions: Only one candidate per family is eligible
Candidate who has availed financial assistance under similar schemes from the State or Government of India is not eligible
Candidates must seek admission to an accredited university/institution abroad
Selected candidate must join the university/institution within six months of selection communication; no extension is permitted
Candidate shall not change the course of study or research for which the scholarship was sanctioned
Applicants must have Aadhar linked with bank account
Applicants must have a valid passport and active bank account
benefits_summary: Provides up to 100% tuition fee coverage (or 50% up to ₹5,00,000) for eligible students, paid in installments, along with one‑way economy class air tickets and visa fee reimbursement.
